name: refracted-twilight-banish-copy-tag
notes: Refracted Twilight is seeded directly onto the field (its own Banish ability doesn't care how it got there, and Brewing isn't the clause under test); it and a second Potion (Potion of Healing) are seeded at myField-1/myField-2, but activateAbilityAbilities['me0xxw0plq:0'] (GeneratedMacroCode.php) banishes Refracted Twilight itself as part of the activation cost BEFORE offering the target choice, which reindexes Potion of Healing down to myField-1 -- verified live by dumping the decision queue between actions (an initial guess of myField-2 for the target click failed with 'Invalid selection'). customDQHandlers['me0xxw0plq:0:ActivateAbility-1'] then tags the chosen target with TurnEffect 'me0xxw0plq_COPY2' (consumed elsewhere, GameLogic.php ~6873, when that potion is next activated -- out of scope for this fixture). Verified final state: myField-1 (Potion of Healing) carries TurnEffects ['ENTERED_THIS_TURN','me0xxw0plq_COPY2'], and Refracted Twilight itself sits in myBanish.

rulesClauses: Banish Refracted Twilight: The next time you activate an ability of target Potion this turn, copy that ability twice. You may choose new targets for those copies.
